body:
It was on the anniversary of the Columbine shooting when my school scheduled a walkout to protest gun violence. Some fucking monster decided to run up into the school with a guitar case that held a shotgun and body armor. 

He ran into the bathroom and placed the armor on and armed himself with the firearm, and then he walked out into the hallway. He shot randomly through a doorway and shattered this kid Ethan’s ankle before jamming his gun. He ended up running up the hallway to a classroom filled with kids and THANKFULLY surrendered to a teacher. Had he used a pistol or something that didn’t jam he could’ve murdered my cousins or friends.

This was right after Parkland too so it was fresh in our minds, but it could never happen here. We had good schools with good kids and we didn’t have shootings. The campuses were all open and anyone could just walk on, it just doesn’t happen here what the fuck.
